elements.description:
The person's own conclusions, assumptions and things to verify – editable, reorderable from the keyboard,
removable with Undo, and exported with provenance.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: The notes, each in the list its `kind` names

properties.name: sections
properties.default: [ { id: "conclusions", label: "Conclusions", addLabel: "Add a conclusion", empty: "No conclusions yet" }, { id: "assumptions", label: "Assumptions", addLabel: "Add an assumption", empty: "No assumptions yet" }, { id: "verify", label: "Still to verify", addLabel: "Add something to verify", empty: "Nothing to verify yet" }, ]
properties.description: The lists, in order – by default Conclusions, Assumptions and Still to verify

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the group's name

properties.name: ownLabel
properties.description: The tag that sets the notes apart from the model's output

properties.name: sessionId
properties.description: The session the notes belong to – shown on the tray and exported with them

properties.name: author
properties.description: Who wrote the notes – shown on the tray and exported with them

properties.name: undoFor
properties.description: How long Undo stays after a removal, in ms; it waits while the pointer or focus is on it. `Infinity` keeps it until the next removal

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-notes-change
events.description: A note was added, edited, moved, removed or brought back; detail `{ notes }`: SynthesisNotesChange. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the change out until the app passes the list back.

events.name: tc-export
events.description: Export was pressed; detail `{ notes, sections, sessionId, author, heading, markdown }`: SynthesisExport.

functions.name: synthesisMarkdown
functions.signature: synthesisMarkdown(notes: SynthesisNote[], sections: SynthesisSection[], meta: { heading?: string; sessionId?: string; author?: string }): void
functions.description: The notes as Markdown: a heading, the provenance line, one list per section (empty ones left out)

props.name: notes
props.description: The notes (controlled): the lists show exactly these and ask for changes through onChange. Leave it undefined to let the element keep them, starting at `defaultNotes`

props.name: defaultNotes
props.description: The notes to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole list after any change, controlled or not

props.name: onExport
props.description: Shows Export and is called with the notes, their provenance and a Markdown copy when it's pressed

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the group's name
